study.question: On the under_normalized host, does static norm-seed capacity beat no growth in late-epoch development CE by more than delta_pc? A pass establishes a measured, repairable deficit for a later, redesigned graft study.
based_on: positive-control-v1 read instrument_failure (PDR-0047): the scheduled arm diverged in 12/48 units and the runner aborted those units. That is now a recorded per-arm outcome.

positive-control-v1 exploratory estimate on all 48 units: static - no growth -0.159 [-0.187, -0.131] (95%). It was SEEN. This study is a confirmatory replication on fresh seeds, not an independent discovery.

units.definition: one training seed; the three arms share initialization and every minibatch and are matched repeated measures
units.population_note: Inference covers training randomness on one fixed data sample (data_seed 20261004), one host pathology and one seed type.

endpoint.metric: development cross-entropy (nats) over all 5,000 dev examples
endpoint.per_unit_reduction: mean dev CE over the late epochs per arm; one paired difference per unit

analysis.sealed_arm: The scheduled arm is trained only because the runner always trains all three arms. No contrast involves it. The analysis neither parses its values nor reports its status (completed or diverged), and its divergence cannot fail a unit. The runner's stdout, which prints every arm, goes to seed-N.runner-stdout.sealed. Known, measured exposure: the graft's divergence rate on this host is already public from v1 (12/48).
analysis.test: paired t interval at 95% (single co-primary), percentile bootstrap check
analysis.exclusions: None. Failed units are recorded with tracebacks and never re-run.
analysis.interim_looks: None. Analysis refuses an unfinished fleet.

decision.diverged_arm_policy_note: fail_unit applies to the CONTRAST arms (static, no_growth), neither of which diverged in any of v1's 48 units. A diverged scheduled arm is outside every contrast and does not fail the unit.
decision.delta_rationale: Unchanged from v1 (PDR-0046): twice the later graft floor of 0.05.

readings.control_passes: static - no growth CI upper < -delta_pc: a measured, repairable deficit. A graft study may be designed against it once the lifecycle instability (simic-75be93e372) has a pre-registered fix.
readings.control_fails_static_worse: CI lower > 0: the static birth harms this host. Reopen the configuration choice.
readings.control_imprecise: half-width > delta_pc and neither of the above (needs sd > ~0.34; effectively unreachable). Redesign the endpoint or scale.
readings.control_fails_below_floor: A detected deficit under the floor. A new PDR chooses between a longer horizon or budget and stopping.
readings.control_fails_no_effect: No repairable deficit at this scale. v1's exploratory estimate does not replicate; record it, and the bounded line stops at rung 2 unless a new configuration family is proposed.
readings.instrument_failure: More than 4 failed units or fewer than 3 analysable. With divergence now recorded per arm, this would mean a contrast arm diverged or a new failure class appeared: investigate before any re-run.

sizing.sd_source: 95% upper confidence limit on v1's exploratory 48-unit sd (0.097, 47 df). The sd, not the effect, is borrowed.
sizing.note: v1's exploratory effect (0.159) is not used for sizing. Simulated pass probability (20,000 48-unit studies, sd 0.117, the committed interval code): 0.80 at a true benefit of 0.148, and 0.93 at 0.159.

predictions.expected_reading: control_passes (v1's exploratory interval lies wholly beyond the floor).
predictions.would_surprise: control_fails_no_effect or control_fails_below_floor: a failed replication of v1's exploratory estimate.

disclosures: v1's exploratory 48-unit estimate was seen before this plan was written.
Seeds 6001-6016 were used for the divergence reproduction (PDR-0047) and are excluded.
